title: Flatness of the canonical spectrum-of-stalk morphism
statement: For a scheme X and a point x [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the canonical morphism \operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to X is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].

proof.text: Attach the existing proved instance Scheme.flat_fromSpecStalk. On an affine open through x, the canonical morphism is the spectrum of the stalk localization followed by the open immersion. Localization is flat and flatness is preserved under composition. The instance at Flat.lean:72 invokes the proved affine-open localization calculation at lines 60-68.
